+import pytest
+
+from wtforms.fields import RadioField
+from wtforms.fields import SelectField
+from wtforms.fields import SelectMultipleField
+from wtforms.form import Form
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("field_type", [SelectField, SelectMultipleField, RadioField])
+def test_option_attributes(field_type):
+    class F(Form):
+        item = field_type(
+            choices=[
+                ("a", "<A>", {"class_": "choice", "title": "<tip>", "data_src": "option"}),
+                ("b", "B"),
+            ],
+            render_kw={"class": "parent", "data-src": "field"},
+        )
+
+    data = ["a"] if field_type is SelectMultipleField else "a"
+    form = F(item=data)
+    first, second = list(form.item)
+    assert first.checked is True
+    assert second.checked is False
+    html = str(first())
+    assert 'class="choice"' in html
+    assert 'class="parent"' not in html
+    assert 'data-src="option"' in html
+    assert 'title="<tip>"' in html
+    assert "<A>" in str(first.label)
+    assert 'class="parent"' in str(second())
+    overridden = str(first(class_="call", data_src="call"))
+    assert 'class="call"' in overridden
+    assert 'data-src="call"' in overridden
+    assert form.item.render_kw == {"class": "parent", "data-src": "field"}
+    assert form.item.choices[0][2] == {
+        "class_": "choice", "title": "<tip>", "data_src": "option"
+    }

spec.question: Make per-choice HTML attributes work when iterating `SelectField`, `SelectMultipleField`, and `RadioField`, not only when rendering a native select. The optional attribute dictionary in a choice tuple must become rendering defaults for that choice's bound option, rather than field-constructor arguments. For iterable options, field-level `render_kw` supplies defaults, the choice dictionary overrides those defaults, and arguments supplied when calling the option override both. At each precedence boundary, equivalent spellings recognized by `clean_key`, such as `class`/`class_` and `data-src`/`data_src`, must refer to the same attribute. Preserve existing option IDs, labels, values, and checked state, and do not mutate the field defaults or choice dictionaries. Deliver a unified diff changing production files only.
